title: Best of Vietnam with FREE Cu Chi Tunnels Visit
highlights: From the ancient charm of Hoi An to the vibrant energy of Ho Chi Minh City, immerse yourself in the rich history and culture of Vietnam.
Challenge your limits with a crawl through the narrow tunnels of the Cu Chi Tunnels, a 250-kilometre underground network.
Admire the architectural beauty of the Notre Dame Cathedral in Ho Chi Minh City, a symbol of French colonial influence.
Soar above the lush rainforest on the 5,801-metre-long Ba Na Hills cable car, enjoying panoramic views.
Sail through the stunning landscapes of Halong Bay - kayaking, swimming, and soaking up the sun.

know_before_you_go: ID Proof is mandatory for each individual guest at the time of booking, and upon arrival. PAN Card will not be considered as a valid identity proof. All foreign nationals must carry their passport as a proof of identity.
The official currency of Vietnam is the Vietnamese Dong (VND). It’s advisable to carry some cash for small purchases, though credit cards are widely accepted.
It is advisable that you dress modestly (keeping your upper arms and legs covered) when visiting any religious sites.
Indian tourists can obtain a Vietnam visa online (E-Visa) or upon arrival at the airport with a validity of 30 days. Charges have to be paid by the tourists.
Smoking is prohibited in most public areas therefore, designated smoking areas should be used.
Always carry tissue paper or wet wipes with you as most public toilets in Vietnam do not provide them.
To mitigate health risks, it is strongly advised to refrain from drinking tap water directly in Vietnam. Instead, carry refillable water bottles.
Images are only for representation purposes.

In cases of force majeure events (e.g., natural disasters, political unrest, or other unforeseeable circumstances), [Thrillophilia] reserves the right to reschedule tours & treks or offer alternative itineraries to ensure the safety and well-being of clients and staff.
Please note that prices are dynamic and may change in the peak season and on blackout dates.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the stay property will be charged at actuals.
Kindly do not litter and help keep the destinations clean.
Please note that the timings and duration of pick-up and drop-off transfers may vary based on certain factors like traffic, weather conditions, natural calamities, etc.
Prices may fluctuate with any change in services/hotels. The difference in the cost shall be borne by the client in case of any amendment in the package due to an increase in the number of guests.

If in case any traveller wants to or decides to leave the trip in the middle, all the expenses from that point onwards will be borne by the traveller. Neither the operator nor Thrillophilia will be held responsible for such decisions or for any refund.
It is recommended that you purchase travel insurance. Please note that the travel insurance is not included in the package price.
It is recommended to not crawl inside the Cu Chi tunnels if you have claustrophobia or any other relevant medical condition for such spaces.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Ho Chi Minh City | Sightseeing and Stay
days.desc: Welcome to Vietnam! Upon arrival at the Tan Son Nhat International Airport, get transferred to the hotel in Ho Chi Minh City. Check in and relax for a while before getting transferred for a sightseeing tour of Ho Chi Minh City. Visit the Independence Palace, Notre Dame Cathedral, and the Central Post Office. Explore the War Remnants Museum and learn about the Indochina War's history through its exhibits. Later, board the provided transfer back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Mekong Delta Day Tour
days.desc: On this day, get transferred from the hotel to explore the Mekong Delta on a sightseeing tour. Spend some time at a popular Buddhist shrine in Vietnam, Ving Trang Pagoda, followed by a visit to the Tortoise Islet. Then, take a boat ride from My Tho along the Mekong River and sail past fish cages and floating houses. Later, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Cu Chi Tunnels Tour | Transfer to Da Nang
days.desc: Today, get transferred from the hotel for the Cu Chi Tunnel excursion. Explore the extensive underground network used during the Vietnam War. Learn about its significance and experience crawling through a section of the tunnels. Later, get dropped off at the hotel and check out. Take the provided transfer to the Tan Son Nhat International Airport and board a flight to Da Nang. Upon arrival at Da Nang International Airport, get transferred to the hotel and check in for an overnight stay.

days.title: Cam Thanh Basket Boat Trip | Leisure Day
days.desc: Experience a unique adventure as you get transferred to Cam Thanh. Glide through the coconut forest aboard a traditional bamboo basket boat and witness local fishermen's way of life around you. Also, try your hand at fishing and paddle through the serene waterways. After this immersive experience, get dropped off at the hotel. Enjoy the rest of your day exploring nearby attractions like My Khe Beach and the Dragon Bridge on your own. Later, return to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Excursion to Ba Na Hills
days.desc: Begin your full day tour of Ba Na Hills with a pre-booked transfer from the hotel. Start with an exciting cable car ride from Suoi Mo Station to Marseille Station, taking in the beautiful views along the way. Upon arrival, explore the iconic Golden Hand Bridge, visit the Linh Ung Pagoda, enjoy thrilling rides at Fantasy Park, and learn wine making secrets at the Debay Wine Cellar. After your exploration, get transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Hanoi | Sightseeing and Stay
days.desc: On this day, check out and get transferred to the Da Nang International Airport to board a flight to Hanoi. Upon arrival at Noi Bai International Airport, get driven to the hotel to check in and relax for a while. Then, get transferred for the sightseeing tour. Visit Hanoi's oldest temple - Tran Quoc Pagoda, the Ho Chi Minh complex and the One Pillar Pagoda. Also, head to the Hoan Kiem Lake, and Ngoc Son Temple, among others. Later, take the provided transfer to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Halong Bay Day Cruise
days.desc: Start your day with a pre-booked transfer from your hotel to Tuan Chau Harbour for an exciting Halong Bay Day Cruise. Board the boat and begin by exploring the Sung Sot Cave, the largest cave in Halong Bay. Also, enjoy kayaking, swimming, or a bamboo boat ride. Continue to Ti Top Island for a swim and hike to its peak to enjoy panoramic views. Later, deboard the boat at Tuan Chau Port and get transferred to your hotel for an overnight stay.
